h1: Move your old site or app to a modern stack
overview: We move an aging site or app to a modern framework without losing what matters: your content, your database records and your page addresses. We first inventory what exists, agree the new stack with you, and write scripts that carry the data across. Then we compare the old and new side by side and set up redirects, so users and search engines find the same pages in the new home.

Automated checks of old and new pages

faq: What stacks do you move to?
Usually Next.js, React or Astro with a Node.js backend, hosted on a modern platform. We recommend the lightest option that fits your site, and agree it with you before we begin.
Can you move a site built on a no code tool?
Yes. If the old tool lets you export content or has an API, we pull it across. If not, we copy the pages carefully and tell you which parts need manual checking.
We keep page addresses, titles and descriptions and add redirects where addresses change. This protects what you have, but no migration can promise unchanged rankings.
What happens to my old site?
It stays live until you choose a switch day. We work from a copy, so there is no downtime while we build, and we help on the day you cut over.
